rows.reason: AI reads and proposals need authenticated Product-plane ingress without a second API authority.
contract: Add bounded AI-Ops read, chat and proposal request/response schemas behind existing operator middleware.
tests: Run authenticated/unauthenticated route tests
reject malformed, oversized and mutation-bearing read/chat payloads.
expectedBehavior: Strict bounded responses preserve unknown/unavailable
read/chat routes cannot mutate canonical state.

rows.reason: Human and worker principals require distinct default-deny scopes.
contract: Bind separately authenticated human owner and isolated worker principals to explicit role, tool and provider scopes using non-secret references.
tests: Prove deny-by-default, role separation, revocation and credential-non-exposure with hostile cross-identity attempts.
expectedBehavior: No subscription credential reaches application, browser, model, repository or worker context
no inherited identity or fallback authority.

rows.reason: Accepted A4 surfaces need one existing shell/navigation mount.
contract: Register AI Ops and incident-workspace pages only after A4 acceptance.
tests: Render route/deep-link tests for loading, missing, unavailable and forbidden states
click every new navigation entry.
expectedBehavior: Canonical unknown/unavailable states remain visible
no duplicate shell, fake badge or decorative control.

rows.reason: Lane-local work cannot edit shared scripts, dependencies or lockfiles.
contract: Apply only dependency/script deltas named by sealed accepted lane receipts.
tests: Run lockfile integrity, offline network-free tests, license/security and dependency-necessity checks.
expectedBehavior: Only reviewed necessary packages/scripts land
lanes remain buildable without hidden network/provider calls.

rows.reason: Fail-closed AI controls must live under the canonical command owner.
contract: Add ratified AI_OPS-namespaced controls within the immutable server capability ceiling.
tests: Prove preview/hash/TTL/confirmation/receipt/readback, expiry, replay and hard-denial hostile cases.
expectedBehavior: UI never becomes authority
forbidden money/safety actions remain unreachable
every effect is owner-receipted.

rows.reason: Eligible case transitions need the existing durable material-event channel.
contract: Add ratified AI case-transition kinds and projections to the canonical material stream.
tests: Prove stable identity, occurrence/observation time, dedupe, bounded page, cursor continuity, reconnect and gap handling.
expectedBehavior: No new bus, socket or cursor
consumers see ordered durable eligible transitions or explicit gaps.

rows.reason: AI queue, drop, lag, provider, case and resource facts need canonical health projection.
contract: Register bounded observations without a second telemetry or health authority.
tests: Inject missing, stale, future, dropped, saturated and provider-outage evidence
run core non-degradation soak.
expectedBehavior: Missing telemetry is MISSING/SILENT
authority downgrades
core service remains within signed overhead budgets.

rows.reason: AI reset/reconnect cannot invent a second reset or restart owner.
contract: Reuse only public news/calendar/fx
add managed or AI actions solely as ratified canonical command projections.
tests: Prove public target success
managed all/market/runtime preview-only HTTP 409
account not configured
receipt/readback for any future action.
expectedBehavior: No second reset API, restart owner or cadence owner
unavailable actions remain honest.

rows.reason: Current surface is in-app routing projection only; no canonical incident-linked external delivery owner exists.
contract: After incident-owner ratification, bind page, acknowledgement, escalation and delivery
external email, Telegram, WhatsApp and SNS remain NOT_CONFIGURED
AWS intake remains OWNER_GATED.
tests: Prove destination acceptance/readback, dedupe, expiry, acknowledgement race and delivery-loss alarm using fake endpoints only.
expectedBehavior: No external notification is claimed without an owner receipt
loss and unavailable destinations are operator-visible.

rows.reason: Accepted A4 views must consume the existing Product client/cursor and server truth.
contract: Bind fixture views to canonical authenticated APIs and durable cursor owner.
tests: Exercise loading, stale, missing, gap, reconnect, forbidden and cursor-resume states in the rendered app.
expectedBehavior: Unknown/unavailable remains visible
no browser recomputation, parallel store, polling client or socket.

rows.reason: Incident identity, grouping, fingerprint, severity and lifecycle have no canonical owner.
contract: Director ratifies one owner
A2 supplies only a typed admission projection after ratification.
tests: Prove grouping, split/merge/reopen/close, acknowledgement races, dedupe, persistence and hostile false-green behavior.
expectedBehavior: INCIDENT_OWNER_NOT_CONFIGURED changes only with owner receipt
Ledger remains persistence, not policy.

rows.reason: Evaluator vocabulary exists but no independently deployed sentinel owner is configured.
contract: Bind an external read-only sentinel in a separate failure domain with no trading or patch authority.
tests: Prove independent liveness/readback, stale/missing delivery, main-app outage and sentinel-outage fault cases.
expectedBehavior: Sentinel reports independently and fail-closed
it cannot execute, trade, patch or mint product readiness.

rows.targetSeam: Production owner MISSING; S6 append/retention receipt contracts; canonical Ledger insertion seam
rows.reason: AI provenance requires independently administered append-only/WORM delivery distinct from sentinel execution.
contract: Ratify audit retention, delivery, readback, chain/hash and restoration contract through the canonical Ledger owner.
tests: Prove append chain, tamper detection, delivery loss, retention expiry, restore and independent readback.
expectedBehavior: Audit loss is visible within the signed interval
no worker can rewrite/delete evidence or administer its own audit sink.

rows.reason: Mounted AI components need canonical inventory and supervisor truth.
contract: Insert only ratified AI identities, availability, blockers and component posture into Product runtime projections.
tests: Prove absent, starting, healthy, degraded, unavailable and killed states plus exact blocker propagation.
expectedBehavior: Cockpit receives canonical server truth
AI absence cannot degrade or falsify core readiness.

rows.targetSeam: Production owner/path MISSING; Product command preview/result types are evidence only, not a generic ApprovalRequest/ApprovalReceipt owner
rows.reason: Elevated AI proposals require separately authenticated human approval that no AI/service can satisfy.
contract: Ratify typed approval request/receipt binding artifact, parameters, expiry, principal, reauthentication and execution readback.
tests: Prove expiry, replay, parameter substitution, AI-as-approver, inherited-chat and credential/role-confusion failures.
expectedBehavior: Only the authenticated human owner approves
preview is never approval
release service executes only exact approved artifact.

rows.reason: Browser/synthetic evidence must extend existing probe and connection truth, not create a new health authority.
contract: Add AI surface observations and independent synthetic probes through existing authenticated/readback seams.
tests: Run fake/offline probe, browser-observation schema, stale/future, timeout, restart and visible-unavailable tests.
expectedBehavior: Browser reports observations only
server remains health authority
probe failure is explicit and never decorative green.

rows.reason: Accepted lane gates need one canonical root acceptance mount.
contract: Register sealed lane tests and AI-off/fault gates only after acceptance.
tests: Run focused lane suites, network-free root suite, complete acceptance, hostile false-green and exact exit-code checks.
expectedBehavior: Real failures return nonzero
no fake success
accepted counts and commands are recorded in canonical state/receipt.
